behavior: One server-selected owned source post and explicitly chosen source image are bound to an owned Previewizer template and staged JPEG. Review changes only durable Conversation state; confirmation is separate.
Review pins source PostVersion/media fingerprint, parsed owned template config/revision/hash, staged upload identity and exact decoded JPEG hash/size. Changed facts require a new review.

Confirmation copies the exact validated bytes to a new server-only deterministic storage key, creates an owned MediaAsset with provenance, and appends a durable receipt atomically with Conversation revision.
Original source rows and PostVersion.mediaIds remain unchanged. Selected IDs, exclusions, prior edit history, recent messages and unrelated cart work are preserved.
Concurrent confirmations return the same receipt and produce one sealed object. Exact successful retry reads the prior receipt without rebasing newer state.
Confirmed exports remain readable after service reconstruction, deselection and explicit refresh. Pending review resumes with its template snapshot and staged image URL.

failuresAndLimits.issue: First backend build failed on scoped TypeScript issues; subsequent build passed. Earlier logs are preserved.
Expanded PostgreSQL fixture initially expected pendingPreviewReview instead of public previewReview, and used a flat selection path. Fixture assertions were corrected; product behavior was unchanged.

The server validates JPEG bytes and records the chosen owned template configuration. It does not prove that the rendered pixels were produced from that template. Client Previewizer rendering/mount acceptance remains deferred.
Actual R2 was not called. The injected object store proves application behavior; the SDK test checks create-only request and 412 handling.

A successful sealed-object write followed by a failed/stale DB transaction may leave one unreferenced deterministic object for that review. Retry reuses it safely; no deletion-on-failure or new cleanup service was introduced.

No frontend mount/test/build/lint/typecheck/render, installed-extension execution, paid semantic evaluation, actual-account write, production migration, deployment, env change or API restart. The mock demo remains unchanged; publishing stays manual.

The full backend suite is not claimed green. The previously recorded generic PostgreSQL competing-session error-code assertion and three distribution-package fixture failures are outside this ticket and were not rerun or fixed.
PCB-04 through PCB-06 remain planned and are not dispatched. Durable destination variants, Rail cues and manual extension packages are separate connections.
